claude-s · ugc-edit

A creator cut with a product demo and a collection

ugc with a product demo mixed in, and one of those collection moments. no real video, so use the template: a founder on why their portfolio was invisible, vertical.

What the skill did

  • With no footage, it voiced an 11-line script with Chatterbox and drew A, B and wide cams. Stackwell and Mira Okafor are made up. 12 shots, 25 s.
  • The hook: the shot opens from a blur. A title lockup puts the small words above and below the keyword, which slams in and takes a glint. The next line runs one word at a time.
  • The collection: eight perforated stamps land one per word into a cracked, coffee-stained pile. Two are stills pulled from the footage, standing in for your photos. Six are drawn as riso art because there were no more photos.
  • The product mix: a proof card pops up under the chin as the founder names the product. Then it takes over the frame and becomes the app: the rows tick, the pointer clicks Publish and a toast lands. A stat counts to 12,000 and throws off two ghost copies.
  • Reel grammar: chips pop in round the head; a numbered chapter card; a riso poster series flipped every 0.4 s (ink grain, a blurred ghost echo, inks off register); the footage shrinks to a window behind giant spoken words; a portal wipe from the chest into the end card.
  • The review: 11 of 11 cuts have a sound, 10 of 10 subs land on a cut, and the final mix transcribes back with no word errors.
  • The second and third clips are the earlier creator cut and the screen-recording tutorial.

Sound

  • Collections: a stamp thunk for each item that lands, thinned to one per 70 ms and tapered so the pile never gets louder. Posters: a flick and a paper tap per flip. Chips: a rising bloop each.
  • The proof card: a pop, then a shine on its light sweep. The app's click and toast sit about 6 dB over the usual UI level, because the product is the focus there.
  • The portal: a reverse riser ending on the cut, plus a sub boom. Before the chapter card the bed drops out for 0.35 s, then changes from the pad to an arp.
  • Sub +6 dB over the voice, below 150 Hz only; air and micro -14; the bed 12 dB under with 8 dB of ducking. Mastered to -14 LUFS at -1 dBTP.
